content: Current IRE/Nexus GMCP documentation covers Char.Vitals, Char.Items with live inventory/room updates, Char.Skills requests, Room info, IRE.Display, and IRE.Target. Achaea-specific sources also show Room.Info shape and a recent fog change that can hide GMCP/name information, so hunting helpers must treat GMCP as authoritative when present but degrade safely when information is unavailable.
